title: Young Woman on Porch Steps, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo, 1943
back_text_transcription: I just got home from work. Dirty + tired + wanted - Take my picture. Feb. 15, 1943 513
description: A clear, candid 1943 black and white snapshot photograph depicting a young woman sitting on the porch steps of a brick building. She is styled in classic WWII-era 1940s fashion with victory rolls, a pinstriped blouse, tailored blazer, plaid skirt, and loafers with socks. The back features a heartfelt handwritten inscription dated February 15, 1943, noting she had just come home tired from work, capturing a personal glimpse into American home-front life during World War II.
